selected_script.angle: oven glass door grease fog smeared worse by generic glass cleaner
selected_script.hook: Squinting through a heavily grease-fogged oven door, trying to see the food inside, while a standard glass cleaner just makes the brown baked-on grease smear into a cloudy mess.

script_record.segment_01: Can't even see what you're baking? Glass cleaners just smear oven grease into a sticky, cloudy mess.
script_record.segment_02: That's why I switched to NUAN. Just spray the heavy-duty foam directly onto that baked-on grime and let it sit for a minute.
script_record.segment_03: Wipe it away, and it cuts right through! Plus, it has a fresh peach scent. Finally, a clear view of dinner.
script_record.broll_coverage: No voiceover needed. Independent functionality footage.
